question: Can a bounded memory hold two operator rules across alternating interference, cold-recall the first, and reuse both in a novel two-stage composition with only two new observed consequences, relative to destructive aliasing, no memory, fitted frequency and exact full Bayesian inference?
hypothesis: A context-indexed top-three per-operator memory with one fixed observation-likelihood-gated composition recall improves B composition Brier >=10% relative to ungated two-slot memory; return-A Brier at least 25% better than last-B overwrite; both A and B Brier within 10% of fully retained exact Bayesian per-context posterior; composition Brier <=110% of strongest same-information no-memory or gated-full-Bayes control. The measured combination must pass all conditions to justify further research, not promotion.

predecessor_evidence.note: YNCA10 finite operator-table memory tied exact Bayes on 128 new single-operator worlds; no multioperator retention, interference or composition tested, remains draft.
CKAD native integrated cumulative learner independent, not touched

inputs.name: Synthetic 3-bit Boolean operators, 24 fixed orbit-representative candidate tables sampled once from all 256; two distinct hidden operators per cohort, world-specific input permutations, 12% independent observation flips

pass_A.status: Exploratory already consumed, source not preregistered before first run
pass_A.diagnosis: Context-specific bank protects earlier operator; composing can overtrust partially learned memory. One fixed correction: likelihood-gated trust of top3 memory versus uniform 24-table prior.

pass_B.status: Not inspected/consumed at prereg; independent source-frozen development
task_types: A cold return after final B block

frozen_design.source_data: A,B operators sampled without replacement from 24 fixed orbit-representative truth tables; per world role permutation is unknown to learner but allowed to evaluator. Four training blocks of 4 worlds each, A4-B4-A4-B4; 4 random noisy observed interventions per training world. No labels from test target beyond fixed observed samples enter fitting.
mechanisms: Independent posterior over 24 candidate tables per context, marginalized over 6 world-specific input permutations
Top3 truncated weighted memory for A and B, serializable, with 6 entries total
Fixed gated recall for C: posterior odds of stored model versus untrained uniform model given only the same two real composition observations; no extra data, 0.5 prior model odds
controls: No-memory exact uniform 24-table per slot Bayesian posterior on new observations
Fully trained untagged pooled context posterior, same 16 training worlds
Last B-only posterior substituted for A as catastrophic-overwrite negative control
Fully trained per-context observed-action frequency with Laplace smoothing, same 16 training worlds
Full exact Bayesian posterior retaining 24 tables per context, same context-labeled training worlds
Observation-likelihood-gated full exact Bayesian memory, same 0.5 initial model odds
True-operator-table oracle with unknown per-world role permutation, privileged diagnostic only
frozen_design.capacity: Candidate two banks of 3 operator tables + weights each. All strong controls may retain 24 tables per context. No new primitive beyond fixed Boolean hypothesis grammar; composition operation explicitly provided equally to all models.
frozen_design.evaluator: Noisy observed input/output pairs only given to policies, true operator/role permutation used only for scoring predictions on all unobserved interventions. Brier lower better, evaluated separately A/B/C; fixed 64 worlds per task and same observations for all policies, no post-result tuning.
frozen_design.source_rule: Git prereg -> source+tests commit verified by SHA256/Blob -> bind hashes to prereg before B use -> one two-OS B evaluation. A can be replayed in focused tests but is exploratory and cannot be promoted as confirmatory evidence.
frozen_design.runtime: CPython 3.12 standard library, PythonHASHSEED=0, GitHub-hosted Ubuntu and Windows <=20 minutes/job; no owner/self-hosted runner, model weights, GPU, paid API or production credentials.
frozen_design.whole_process_cost: Measure wall clock and memory optionally; no energy or speedup claim without matched instrumented data. 6 vs 48 hypotheses is a storage distinction only.

controls: Exact full 24-table/context Bayesian and model-evidence-gated exact Bayes
Privileged true table oracle for diagnostic
metrics: Brier on unobserved interventions for A, B, C separately
A after B retention gain vs overwritten baseline
C composition gain vs ungated same top3 memory
Brier parity against strongest no-memory and full gated Bayes
Cold JSON restart parity with numerical tolerance <=1e-12
Saved posterior table count and model/evaluation process cost
Source hashes and Linux/Windows byte-identical original B results

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL only if B: (i) GATED_TOP3 Brier on novel C <=0.90x TWO_SLOT_TOP3 C, (ii) GATED_TOP3 C <=1.10x min(NO_MEMORY C,GATED_FULL_BAYES C), (iii) GATED_TOP3 return A <=0.75x LAST_B_OVERWRITE return A and <=1.10x FULL_CONTEXT_BAYES A, (iv) GATED_TOP3 B <=1.10x FULL_CONTEXT_BAYES B, (v) 3 entries per memory and successful new-process cold-restore within 1e-12. This is positive development only; no scientific superiority claim over exact Bayes.
classification_rules.mixed: Return-A genuinely improves over overwrite and composition gating improves ungated but C or full Bayes parity thresholds fail; DEVELOPMENT_MIXED, stop this variant after A+B and preserve effect.
classification_rules.negative: No substantial retained A memory or composition gating worsens C; DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO. Do not tune B cohort or run extra seeds to rescue.
classification_rules.invalid: First B use before source/prereg SHA lock, source/seed/metric changes after B, unequal interventions, hidden table/role leakage, missing full exact Bayesian controls, cross-OS inconsistent output, or missing scientific custody; failing cold restore is separate engineering if B scored output is valid.

prohibited_after_primary_run: Change evidence gate weight or candidate K on B
Rerun fresh B seeds to postselect a win
Call fixed Boolean grammar and supplied composition rule open-ended invention
Modify CKAD native learner, main accepted model, controller, scheduler, owner runtime or deployments
note: Exact GitHub experiment+tests bound before B first-use; exploratory A from local source SHA00bd is consumed, not confirmatory. No post-B model modification or cohort reuse.
